page_title: HAV 0-0 LEN | Le Havre v Lens 20/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+4' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Lens due to an offside in the build-up play.
90+3' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible offside. The Lens players aren’t happy.
90+2' Florian Sotoca (Lens) heads the ball low inside the right post after a splendid cross. This timely header produces a wonderful moment.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
88' The manager makes a subsitution with Nolan Mbemba (Le Havre) coming on for Abdoulaye Toure.
87' Luka Elsner has decided to substitute Mohamed Bayo and he is replaced by Andy Logbo (Le Havre).
85' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Adrien Thomasson trots off the pitch and is replaced by Neil El Aynaoui (Lens).
83' Samuel Grandsir (Le Havre) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
82' Lens enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
81' The attendance for today's match is 23590.
76' We are about to witness a subsitution. Issa Soumare (Le Havre) for Emmanuel Sabbi.
76' Luka Elsner has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Samuel Grandsir (Le Havre) replacing Nabil Alioui.
74' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Facundo Medina (Lens) comes onto the pitch for Massadio Haidara.

73' Florian Sotoca (Lens) wastes a great chance from the resulting corner. He times his header superbly when he leaps high to meet a precise cross, but can't aim better than into the middle of the goal, straight into the arms of the goalkeeper.
73' Angelo Fulgini (Lens) is about to take a corner kick.
71' Mohamed Bayo (Le Havre) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players.
69' Massadio Haidara (Lens) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Le Havre.
65' Arouna Sangante (Le Havre) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.
64' Franck Haise decides to make a substitution. Nampalys Mendy will be replaced by Salis Abdul Samed (Lens).
64' Morgan Guilavogui (Lens) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Wesley Said.
62' Josue Casimir (Le Havre) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger. The ball has crossed the sideline. Le Havre are taking a throw-in.

61' Mohamed Bayo (Le Havre) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball down to the middle of the goal. Brice Samba shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
60' Great teamplay by Lens as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.

53' Mohamed Bayo (Le Havre) starts an individual run, not looking to pass to a teammate, and easily weaves through the defence to get deep inside the box. He shoots low, but misses the goal by a whisker! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lens.

50' Mohamed Bayo (Le Havre) latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box, but miskicks his shot and the ball goes high over the bar. Poor effort! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lens.

48' Nabil Alioui (Le Havre) receives a lofted pass from the side and shoots from around the penalty spot, but the ball flies slightly over, almost brushing the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lens.
46' Half-time substitution. Franck Haise decided to make a change. Andy Diouf is replaced by Angelo Fulgini (Lens).
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+2' Nabil Alioui (Le Havre) fails to produce a decent cross from the corner kick. The ball goes well out of play.
45+1' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Lens.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
40' Arouna Sangante (Le Havre) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.

39' What a save from Brice Samba! Emmanuel Sabbi (Le Havre) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant stop to keep it out. The referee signals a corner kick to Le Havre.

35' Mohamed Bayo (Le Havre) misses a big chance! He fires the ball high over the crossbar from inside the 6-yard box after the ball rebounded to him. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lens.
34' Przemyslaw Frankowski (Lens) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.

32' A great touch by Wesley Said (Lens) as he latches on to a brilliant cross inside the box. He drills a low shot towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper reacts superbly to keep the ball out. What a stunning reflex save!
29' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Emmanuel Sabbi (Le Havre) was quite harsh and Francois Letexier didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
26' Mohamed Bayo (Le Havre) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the bottom right corner. However, Brice Samba anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save.

25' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) latches on to a precise lofted cross inside the box, controls the ball and drills a fine strike towards the middle of the goal. His dangerous effort is blocked by Arthur Desmas, who makes a glorious save!
22' Problems for Luka Elsner as Christopher Operi is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Loic Nego (Le Havre) replaces him.
22' Nabil Alioui (Le Havre) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
21' Looks like Nabil Alioui (Le Havre) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
19' The referee demonstrates he won't tolerate this behaviour. Kevin Danso (Lens) is given a yellow card.
19' Massadio Haidara (Lens) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Le Havre.
17' Yoann Salmier (Le Havre) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.

17' Fine play by Daler Kuzyaev (Le Havre) opens up space on the edge of the box for the shot, but his effort lacks accuracy and flies miles over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Lens will have a goal kick.
15' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Nabil Alioui (Le Havre). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.

14' Nabil Alioui (Le Havre) goes on a mazy run and tries his luck with a mid-range strike, but one of the defending players steps in and makes a block. The ball goes behind for a corner. Le Havre will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
12' Andy Diouf (Lens) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Francois Letexier had an easy-decision to make.
11' Lens seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.

8' Przemyslaw Frankowski (Lens) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads low towards the middle of the goal, but Arthur Desmas shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
7' Andy Diouf (Lens) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.

7' Ruben Aguilar (Lens) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. Good work from Lens as they win a corner.
5' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.

4' Andy Diouf (Lens) must feel embarrassed now. He received a killer pass, but his shot from the six-yard box was a disaster. He miskicked and made it very easy for Arthur Desmas to get hold of the ball. Lens have a corner.
2' The Le Havre players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Lens will have the kick-off.
Francois Letexier got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
